profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Expertise in frontend & backend development • Delivered robust web applications for large-scale platforms • Skilled in API design & implementation
profile.summary:
I have over six years of software engineering experience developing comprehensive application stacks to build web applications that enhance user experience and deliver measurable business value.

At iVoyant, I led development of the AT&T Care Product using React and Redux, revamping APIs to better support customer care agents on a high-traffic platform. Before that, at Tortoise, I migrated a mission-critical delivery control system from jQuery to Angular 12, reducing technical debt and significantly improving reliability for internal teleoperators.

I dedicate my time to solving complex problems that affect large systems. My work at Marelli Mexicana involved creating automated SQL workflows for purchase order management, resulting in process optimization. Additionally, I successfully refactored systems while working under tight time constraints.

I dedicate myself to mentoring others because I have guided teams and trained new employees while watching them develop into skilled team members. The process of watching others achieve success brings me the most satisfaction during my work activities.

My professional experience began with safety testing and production planning work in automotive and medical manufacturing sectors. My software development experience has demonstrated to me how programming code enables physical operations and provided me with an understanding of system interactions with real-world systems.

I dedicate my free time to open-source development and write detailed articles about technical subjects that interest me. I also enjoy testing new developer tools and programming languages. I spend my time customizing my .vimrc file because I am a Vim enthusiast.

I will collaborate on every project while maintaining accessibility for discussions about project concepts and speaking engagements.

You can contact me through carlos.gutierrez@carg.dev for any purpose.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded frontend development of a major customer support platform using React, Redux, and WebSockets, while collaborating on API redesign and deployment process optimization, resulting in improved agent efficiency and faster iteration cycles.
•	Architected and led the transformation of an internal initiative into a scalable B2B SaaS product, delivering full-stack features using NestJS and React, and defining the technical vision for long-term product growth.
•	Reimagined legacy UI workflows by replacing table-based interactions with drag-and-drop interfaces, unlocking an estimated $20M/year in operational savings.
•	Reduced CI/CD build times from 45 minutes to 2 minutes via Azure Pipelines, accelerating the software delivery lifecycle.
•	Programmed and released multi-account authentication and access workflows with SSO using Java 17 (Spring Boot), enabling secure, granular permissions for over 200 enterprise clients.
•	Delivered multi-month roadmap features within compressed timelines in 1 month, including subscription logic enhancements, dynamic plan configurations, and support for emerging device categories—all shipped ahead of schedule.
•	Implemented mechanized fraud detection measures, such as 2FA for high-risk interactions, reducing fraudulent call activity and improving platform security.
•	Led the rapid delivery of FTC-compliant account restrictions in under a month, supporting safety and privacy mandates, including protections for users in crisis situations.
•	Built and deployed zero-defect orchestrated voice authentication features for IVR systems in just 24 hours, improving the caller experience and security.
•	Championed clean architecture practices, service decoupling, and DevOps automation across teams to promote scalable, maintainable delivery.
•	Mentored junior engineers and collaborated across product, backend, and QA teams to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, and consistent velocity.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
•	Migrated a critical delivery control system, migrating from jQuery to Angular 12, reducing tech debt and improving stability for internal tele-operators.
•	Deployed backend services to GCP using PM2 process management, ensuring consistent and resilient service availability.
•	Improved and executed a Linux-based automated update pipeline with .deb packaging and APT repositories, enabling fleet-wide, touch-free updates for delivery robots.
•	Engineered real-time communication systems using MQTT and TCP/IP protocols to monitor and control autonomous scooters and delivery devices.
•	Strengthened operational reliability by optimizing backend systems for distributed robotics infrastructure.
